name: wantAnimId
meaning: Animation the crowd should be playing; Update starts it whenever it differs from anim.animId (+0x5a). HandleMessage picks it at random from a pair: 0/2 for msg 0x6580, 1/3 for msg 0x6581.

name: reactionTimerMs
meaning: Random 0..1499 ms value stored on each reaction message and decremented by g_dtMs, but only on the single frame the animation actually changes.
